scripts.validate: bun run typecheck && bun run eslint:lint && bun test
scripts.dev:all: bun install && concurrently "bun --filter @tgslots/api dev" "bun --filter @tgslots/web-client dev" "bun --filter @tgslots/marketing dev"
scripts.dev:x7: bun run x7:config && docker compose -p tgslots-x7 -f compose.x7.yml up -d --wait rabbitmq && concurrently --kill-others "RABBITMQ_URL=${RABBITMQ_URL:-amqp://x7:x7-demo@127.0.0.1:${X7_AMQP_PORT:-5672}} X7_LISTEN_ADDR=${X7_LISTEN_ADDR:-127.0.0.1:${X7_HTTP_PORT:-3003}} go -C apps/x7-server run ." "RABBITMQ_URL=${RABBITMQ_URL:-amqp://x7:x7-demo@127.0.0.1:${X7_AMQP_PORT:-5672}} bun --filter @tgslots/x7-math-worker dev" "X7_BACKEND=go-rabbit PORT=${X7_API_PORT:-3001} X7_SERVER_URL=${X7_SERVER_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:${X7_HTTP_PORT:-3003}} bun run dev:api" "X7_PROXY_URL=${X7_PROXY_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:${X7_HTTP_PORT:-3003}} API_PROXY_URL=${API_PROXY_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:${X7_API_PORT:-3001}} bun run --cwd apps/web-client dev --port ${X7_CLIENT_PORT:-3002} --strictPort" "VITE_GAME_CLIENT_URL=${VITE_GAME_CLIENT_URL:-http://localhost:${X7_CLIENT_PORT:-3002}} bun run --cwd apps/marketing dev --port ${X7_MARKETING_PORT:-3004} --strictPort"
scripts.dev:nine-lives: concurrently --kill-others "PORT=3401 bun --filter @tgslots/api dev" "API_PROXY_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3401 bun run --cwd apps/web-client dev --port 3402 --strictPort" "VITE_GAME_CLIENT_URL=http://localhost:3402 bun run --cwd apps/marketing dev --port 3404 --strictPort"
